input.summary: Replace Licensor's unilateral 7-year renewal option with mutual 12-month renewals and a capped price uplift
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a seven-year renewal exercisable at the Licensor's sole option; our playbook requires renewal only by mutual written agreement (or 12-month renewals we can exit on 30 days' notice), consistent with subsections II and III of this Article. We have also capped any renewal price increase at the lesser of CPI and 3%.

ops.oldText: The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor.
ops.newText: Thereafter, this Agreement may be renewed only by mutual written agreement of the parties for successive renewal periods of twelve (12) months each, and any increase in fees for a renewal period shall not exceed the lesser of the increase in the Consumer Price Index over the preceding twelve (12) months and three percent (3%).
